title: John Muir College General Education
source_note: Muir 学院官网学位要求页 + UCSD catalog（2026-10-28 核对）；批准序列按学期公布，只写规则 + 链接。

sections.title: Writing

requirements.name: Muir College Writing Program
requirements.note: MCWP 40 + MCWP 50, letter grade, within the first two years. MCWP 41 (if assigned) does not satisfy the first part.
requirements.note_zh: MCWP 40 + MCWP 50，须 letter grade，两年内完成；如被要求先修 MCWP 41，该课不算第一部分。

requirements.name: Writing for transfer students
requirements.note: CalGETC/UC IGETC-certified transfer students take MCWP 125 instead of MCWP 40/50. Letter grade.
requirements.note_zh: CalGETC/UC IGETC 认证转学生修 MCWP 125 代替 MCWP 40/50，须 letter grade。

sections.note_zh: MCWP 40 + 50（转学生 MCWP 125），须 letter grade。

sections.title: General Education Sequences

requirements.name: Category I: Social Sciences
requirements.note: One three-course sequence (three courses in the same department) in Social Sciences, chosen from the college-approved sequences published each quarter.
requirements.note_zh: 社会科学方向 3 门序列（同一系 3 门），按学院每学期公布的批准序列选。

requirements.name: Category II: Mathematics or Natural Sciences
requirements.name_zh: 第二类：数学或自然科学
requirements.note: One three-course sequence in Mathematics (calculus) or Natural Sciences, chosen from the college-approved sequences published each quarter.
requirements.note_zh: 数学（微积分）或自然科学方向 3 门序列，按学院每学期公布的批准序列选。

requirements.name: Category III: two sequences
requirements.note: Two three-course sequences chosen from two of: Fine Arts, Humanities, Foreign Languages, from the college-approved sequences published each quarter.
requirements.note_zh: 另两个 3 门序列，从美术、人文、外语三区中选两个区，按学院每学期公布的批准序列选。

sections.note: Four 3-course sequences, 12 courses (48 units), from quarterly approved lists.
sections.note_zh: 4 个 3 门序列共 12 门（48 学分），按学期批准清单选。

sections.title: Transfer Students

requirements.name: IGETC / reciprocity
requirements.note: Transfer students who completed IGETC before transfer may waive the GE sequences above (MCWP 125 still required). Students with breadth requirements completed at another UC campus may submit a letter of reciprocity. Up to three major courses may overlap GE.
requirements.note_zh: 转学前完成 IGETC 者可免上述 GE 序列（仍须 MCWP 125）；在另一 UC 校区完成通识/广度要求者可交 reciprocity 信函免序列；最多 3 门专业课可与 GE 重叠。

sections.note: IGETC waives sequences; up to 3 major courses may overlap.
sections.note_zh: IGETC 可免序列；最多 3 门专业课重叠。
